text:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing a ~3hr pulse of 429s from embed-api since the canary rolled out. Alert spam across multiple routes at p95. Current alert is `embed-api/response_429_rate > 0.5% over 5m` and it's noisy right now. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/xyz/embed-api-rate · Traces: https://traces.redwood.com/trace/abc

alert-bot: [ALERT] embed-api/response_429_rate firing (fired 18 times) · p95 spike at 0.9% · triggered at 2026-03-17T09:14:20Z

devon: Can we do a short threshold bump + a suppression window? My quick take: raise to 1.5% for 20m and add a routing fallback to older model for the heaviest routes. Avoid full silence. :thinking_face:

anjali: Do we know source? Could be a retry storm from a single customer — if so, routing change + a rate-limited fallback is safer than global threshold changes. Can you paste a log sample?

maria: yep, looks like repeated retries from a single client key. snippet: `ts=2026-03-17T08:58:02Z level=info route=/v1/embed size=768 customer_id=acme-123 status=429 attempts=5` — ~4.2k requests in 30m from that key. I put a trace link for one request above.

leo: +1 to targeted approach. If it's one customer we can mitigate with a customer-level throttle and a temporary rule. But while we set that, a short lived threshold bump avoids pager fatigue.

devon: Proposed ops steps (quick):
```
# prometheus rule patch (temporary)
- alert: EmbedHigh429Temp
  expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embed-api",code="429"}[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embed-api"}[5m]))) > 0.015
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```
And create an Alertmanager silence for 20m scoped to the alert name and cluster: `suppress:EmbedHigh429Temp:20m`

maria: That looks fine to me. I'll open a small branch with the patch and a runbook note. Can someone apply the silence in Alertmanager once the branch merges?

anjali: I'll take the customer throttle. Adding a temporary policy on the edge for `customer_id=acme-123` to cap to 100r/s and exponential backoff.

devon: Took the patch and will merge + apply silence. I'll post the silence ID here when done. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Planned action logged — temp rule applied by devon, customer throttle applied by anjali. If 429 rate drops below 0.5% for 30m we'll revert changes automatically via the revert job.

maria: Thanks team. After this settles, we should add a dashboard panel per-customer 429 rate and a short alertdoc describing targeted mitigations (customer throttle vs threshold bump).

leo: Agreed. Also please add a note to the rollout checklist to watch `embed-api` 429 by `customer_id` for the first hour after canary.

devon: Silence ID: silence-20260317-1234 (applied). Monitoring closely.

maria: Closing the loop: rates falling, alert noise reduced. Will keep this thread updated if anything changes. :thumbsup:
